textFacts.fact: Root cause: TokenBucket.refill (gateway/ratelimit/bucket.go) truncated elapsed time to whole seconds and reset last_refill on every call, discarding sub-second time, so under steady traffic the bucket barely refilled. Fixed by computing the refill from elapsed milliseconds and advancing last_refill only by the time the added whole tokens represent (remainder carried over).

The interim burst_capacity increase from 40 to 80 in config/limits.yaml was abandoned and reverted; burst stays at 40 because the tenant contract caps it there, the hotfix plan is withdrawn, and limits.yaml is not part of the fix.

go test ./gateway/ratelimit/... passed (23 tests, including the new refill and replay tests) and the -race run passed; the staging k6 load test (loadtest/tenant_burst.js) was NOT run, and real multi-node Redis was not tested (tests use miniredis).

Next: get the expired staging/gateway-loadtest credentials rotated by the platform team, run the k6 staging load test with the acme-west profile and confirm zero 429s, and only then canary the fix to 5% of acme-west traffic before full rollout.
Symptom: after the v3.4 rollout acme-west got HTTP 429s below its contracted 5 requests/second (replay: 1,094 of 2,861 requests rejected on v3.4.0, none on v3.3.2).
The clock-skew hypothesis was ruled out (largest NTP offset 1.7 ms; reproduced on a single node).

The Redis key schema rl:{tenant}:{route}, the tokens/last_refill_ms fields and the integer token type were kept unchanged for compatibility with v3.4.0 nodes during the rolling deploy (fractional/float tokens rejected).
The change is on draft PR #2214 (not merged), with new tests in gateway/ratelimit/bucket_test.go (e.g. TestRefillSubSecondIntervals, TestReplayAcmeWestWindow).

textFacts.fact: Root cause: PR #881 changed format_row in reports/export/csv_writer.py to a naive datetime.fromtimestamp(row.event_ts), producing Australia/Sydney local time mislabelled with a Z suffix; the fix restores the explicit UTC conversion (tz=timezone.utc).

Converting in SQL (AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' in reports/export/query.sql) was tried and abandoned because the same query feeds the dashboard timeline; the conversion happens only at CSV serialization, query.sql is unchanged, the event_time header/ISO-8601 Z format must not change (finance loader contract), and the worker hosts keep TZ=Australia/Sydney.

pytest tests/export passed (41 tests, including the two new regression tests); the full nightly job against a production snapshot was NOT run (read-replica window booked for tomorrow) and no backfill has been run.

Next: after PR #903 is approved and deployed, run python scripts/backfill_exports.py --from 2026-10-03 --to 2026-10-11 to regenerate the nine affected files, then tell the finance team which files were replaced.

Symptom: exported event_time values were 10 hours late on 2026-10-03/04 and 11 hours late from 2026-10-05 (Sydney DST start); nine nightly files (2026-10-03 to 2026-10-11) are affected, files up to 2026-10-02 are correct.
Setting TZ=UTC on the worker hosts was rejected because invoice-reminder and payroll cron jobs on those hosts are scheduled in Sydney local time.

New regression tests test_format_row_emits_utc and test_format_row_dst_boundary in tests/export/test_csv_writer.py fail on the PR #881 code and pass with the fix; the fix is in review as PR #903, not merged.
The region-health indicator, whose specification is the attached reference image, has not been started; it comes after the export fix ships.

visualFacts.fact: The image is divided into two equal halves by a vertical split (left half and right half).
The left half is solid red.
The right half is solid blue.
There is no text, label, icon or control in the image; it is two flat color fields.

textFacts.fact: CI and local development moved to Node 22.11.0 (.nvmrc, ci.yml matrix 22.x for x64 and arm64, engines >=22.11 <23), and node-sass was replaced by sass 1.80.6 (Dart Sass) with the .scss sources unchanged.

Building node-sass@9 from source was tried and abandoned (6 min 40 s x64 build, node-gyp failure on arm64); no native Sass build, and no move to Node 24 because the LTS policy keeps Node 22 until April 2027.
Locally on Node 22, npm ci and npm run build succeeded and npm test passed (312 tests in 52 suites); the x64 CI job on PR #418 is green; the arm64 CI job has NOT run (arm64 runner pool offline).
Next: when the arm64 runner pool is back, re-run the arm64 job on PR #418 and merge PR #418 if it passes; the attached status table must be checked before the cutover is scheduled.
--openssl-legacy-provider was removed from NODE_OPTIONS in the build script (webpack 5.95 no longer needs it).
Two whitespace-only snapshot changes in ui/__snapshots__/Button.test.js.snap (Dart Sass output) were reviewed and accepted.
The DEP0040 punycode deprecation warning comes from a transitive dependency (whatwg-url via node-fetch@2) and was left as harmless.
PR #418 is not merged; the main bundle grew from 1.41 MB to 1.42 MB.
